title: ImpedanceMimic: Learned Impedance as Action Space for Force-Accurate Motion Imitation
abstract: arXiv:2611.19153v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Recovering the forces behind a motion is ill-posed: different controllers can reproduce the same movement while generating different contact forces. Physics-based motion imitation resolves this ambiguity through simulation, but relies on fixed-gain proportional-derivative (PD) control. We show that fixed gains impose a trade-off between motion and force tracking, as contact and swing place conflicting demands on joint stiffness and damping. We introduce ImpedanceMimic, a reinforcement-learning policy that modulates per-joint stiffness, damping, and position setpoints from motion and force measurements, but requires only motion at inference. Across 129 participants and six activities, ImpedanceMimic outperforms matched fixed-gain PD under every integration scheme, direct-torque, muscle-actuated and existing imitation controllers in kinematic and force fidelity, approaching a dedicated motion-to-force regressor. translated_title: ImpedanceMimic：以学习到的阻抗作为动作空间实现力精确的运动模仿
translated_abstract: 恢复运动背后的作用力是一个不适定问题：不同的控制器可以复现相同的运动，却会产生不同的接触力。基于物理的运动模仿通过仿真解决了这一歧义，但其依赖于固定增益的比例-微分（PD）控制。我们证明了固定增益在运动跟踪与力跟踪之间存在权衡，因为接触与摆动对关节刚度和阻尼提出了相互冲突的要求。我们提出ImpedanceMimic，这是一种强化学习策略，可根据运动和力的测量数据对每个关节的刚度、阻尼和位置设定点进行调节，但在推理时仅需要运动数据。在129名受试者和六项活动的实验中，ImpedanceMimic在各种积分方案下，在运动学保真度和力学保真度方面均优于匹配的固定增益PD控制器、直接力矩控制、肌肉驱动控制以及现有的模仿控制器，其性能接近专门的运动到力回归器。通过将增益表示为（此处摘要截断）
tldr: 提出ImpedanceMimic强化学习策略，将学习到的逐关节阻抗（刚度、阻尼与位置设定点）作为动作空间，在推理时仅需运动数据即可同时实现高保真的运动模仿与接触力恢复，突破了固定增益PD控制在运动与力跟踪之间的固有权衡。
en_tdlr: ImpedanceMimic uses learned per-joint impedance (stiffness, damping, and position setpoints) as an action space for reinforcement learning, achieving force-accurate motion imitation that outperforms fixed-gain PD control while requiring only motion data at inference.
